# array-frontend: Array<S> entry points, request splitting, compaction, ReadContext read cache

Paths are under jix/src unless they start with jix-py/. "NEW" = new or rewritten since 6dbeb15
(#94 renames, #98 split of array.rs into array/*.rs and move of ReadContext to context.rs, #100
read cache, #102 `view()` -> `Array<&S>`, #103 `Index`, #104 `OutBuf` + pull/push entry split).
CLAUDE.md is partly stale for this area: `to_ndarray_buf`/`to_ndarray_slice` are now
`to_buf_strided` (pull), `to_buf_strided_into` (push) and `to_buf_slice`; `compact_fn`'s callback
always takes `&[u64]` (construct.rs:180, 227).

## Purpose

`Array<S>` (array/mod.rs:157-160) wraps a storage and owns every public read entry point:
`to_ndarray` / `to_ndarray_sub` (read.rs:69, 197), `to_buf_slice` (read.rs:285, packed push),
`to_buf_strided` (read.rs:358, pull), `to_buf_strided_into` (read.rs:423, push), `to_plain`
(read.rs:601). All funnel into `to_buf_strided_checked` (read.rs:450), which enters the read-cache
scope and either forwards one `read_data` ("small read") or cuts the request into pieces
(`to_buf_strided_slow_dyn`, read.rs:509-558). Compaction (`compact`/`compact_with`,
array/compact.rs:54, 94; `compact_into_builder`, :130, shared with `write_to`,
archive/array.rs:435) reads chunks and re-encodes blocks. construct.rs builds Compact arrays from
ndarrays, raw pointers and closures (`FnStorage`, :232-308). `ReadContext` (context.rs:51-64) holds
the zstd decompressor, the buffer pool and the NEW read cache: results of arrays reached more than
once in one expression (`x` in `x + x`) are read once per region (context.rs:104-290, ids in
storage/cache_id.rs).

## Contracts

Provided by the entry points (NEW #103/#104):
- Every public read validates with `check_ranges` (error.rs:228-246: ndim <= NDIM_MAX, one range
  per dim, start <= end <= shape, each length fits usize), splits with `split_ranges`
  (index.rs:98-103), returns BEFORE building an `Index` when any extent is 0, then builds it with
  `Index::new_unchecked`. So storages never see an empty region (`Index` sizes are
  `NonZeroUsize`, index.rs:15-19). Per call: to_ndarray_sub read.rs:182-242; to_buf_slice
  :314-324; to_buf_strided :383-392; to_buf_strided_into :447-456.
- Region size: `check_region_size` (error.rs:298-312, 32-bit only, prod(max(n,1))*itemsize <=
  isize::MAX) in to_buf_slice (:322, AFTER the empty return), to_buf_strided (:385),
  to_buf_strided_into (:450). to_ndarray_sub has its own all-target check (:216-226).
- Push `out`: only `to_buf_strided_into` takes a caller buffer; it runs `check_out_buf_impl`
  (buf.rs:384-431: stride count, writable, no overlap over the region - conservative sort test -
  and span <= slice length) and passes `out.view_mut()` (read.rs:437-438). to_ndarray_sub and
  to_buf_slice build their own trusted outs (ndarray strides read.rs:233-240; packed strides +
  exact length via `check_get_buffer_size` read.rs:294-301, error.rs:270-296).
- `to_buf_strided_checked` (read.rs:447-470) precondition (comment :465-466): index checked
  against shape and region size, push out passes `check_out_buf_impl`.
- Pull results returned by `to_buf_strided` are whatever the storage (small read) or the slow path
  (`OutBuf::materialize`, writable pooled buffer laid out in `read_layout_order`) produced:
  possibly a read-only borrowed view, a 0-stride view, or a read-only `Shared` cache buffer.

Bypasses of the entry points (no `check_ranges`, no Array-level region check):
- `compact_into_builder_dyn` (compact.rs:263-272) builds chunk `Index`es unchecked from the chunk
  grid; used by compact*, compact_fn*, compact_ndarray*, write_to/write_to_file,
  `MaybeCompact::new` (ops/maybe_compact.rs:31-37).
- Every op's inner reads (each derives its own `Index::new_unchecked`).
- Read-cache hits: Compact (storage/compact.rs:246-248) and ReductionOp
  (ops/reduction/common.rs:240) run `check_out_buf` INSIDE the cached closure, so a hit skips it;
  the cache does its own `check_out_buf_impl` for push hits (context.rs:188-190).
- Tests / test_util.rs:1464 call `read_data_*` directly. Users cannot: `OutBuf` constructors are
  pub(crate) (buf.rs:450-467) and `ArrayStorage` is sealed.
- Defense in depth: every storage still calls `check_out_buf` (buf.rs:352-364: range, 32-bit
  region, push out) - it catches internally inconsistent indexes, not self-consistent wrong ones.

Relied on from other modules:
- `read_data` push contract: write every byte of the region at `out`'s strides, nothing outside.
  Needed by `assume_init` (read.rs:243), the uninit chunk buffer (compact.rs:259-272) and the slow
  path. Non-local: every storage, plus the cache-hit copy (buf.rs:491-499).
- Spec invariants, only `debug_assert`ed in `from_storage` (mod.rs:321-351): block_shape len ==
  ndim and > 0; `read_layout_order` / `read_shape_scale_order` are permutations; read_size.min > 0.
  A non-permutation layout order would break `to_ndarray_sub`'s `permuted_axes` (read.rs:220-227,
  ndarray panics) and `strides_for_layout_order` (util/mod.rs:164-179, aliasing/oversized strides
  in pull buffers).
- `ElementType` is sealed, so `Array::dtype()` (mod.rs:211-215, `ET::DTYPE` when static) equals
  `storage.dtype()`; to_ndarray_sub sizes with `size_of::<S::Item>()` and `dtype().itemsize()`.
- `ArrayParams::tune` (params.rs:282-411) now runs `check_shape_overflow` (params.rs:291: dims <=
  i64::MAX, bytes fit u64) and caps a block at BLOCK_SIZE_BYTES_MAX = 1<<30 (lib.rs:432), also
  for compact_fn shapes. `read_size` is user-settable with no cap (params.rs:170-173).

`unsafe fn` preconditions:
- `Array::compact_ndarray_ptr` (pub, construct.rs:131-152): `ptr` readable for every index of
  `shape` at byte `strides`, elements valid `dtype` values, whole strided span in one allocation,
  not written or `&mut`-borrowed during the call; no alignment needed. Caller: user / jix-py.
  Stride count is checked by `Plain::new` (plain.rs:121-125) via `plain_ndarray_ptr`
  (plain.rs:402-428).
- `Index::new_unchecked` (pub(crate), index.rs:37-49): lengths equal and <= NDIM_MAX, no zero
  size, no `start + size` overflow. Only `debug_assert`ed; `start()`/`size()` then
  `assert_unchecked` the length part (index.rs:90-95). Callers here: read.rs:232, 321, 389, 454,
  571-572; compact.rs:264.
- `OwnedBlockTableBuilder::into_table` (block.rs:295, called compact.rs:100): no written
  contract; implicitly every block index written once and decoder dtype == `ET`'s.
- `StridedBuf::from_slice_mut` / `from_shared` / `with_offset` (buf.rs:134, 161, 296): accesses
  implied by strides and the read shape stay in the slice; `_mut` strides do not alias.

Read cache (all NEW, #100, reshaped by #104):
- `read_cached(id, index, dtype, out, read)` (context.rs:148-160): callers pass the storage's own
  `ArrayCacheId`, its dtype, and a closure doing the same read uncached. Callers: Compact
  (storage/compact.rs:246), Op1 (ops/elementwise/op1.rs:65), Op2 (op2.rs:120), Map (map.rs:308),
  Select (select.rs:327), MinMax (min_max.rs:271), reductions (reduction/common.rs:240).
- Key = id plus exact `start` and `size` (context.rs:181-182). dtype is not part of the key.
  Correctness rests on: ids unique (global monotonic counter, cache_id.rs:13-19, never reused),
  storages immutable, and every storage sharing an id holding the same data, shape and dtype:
  `&S`/`&mut S`/`Box`/`Rc`/`Arc`/`&dyn` forwarders (storage/mod.rs:99-208), `ArrayStorageAny`
  clones (any.rs:16-19, spec copied at :107-113), `Compact::as_compact` (storage/compact.rs:136-144)
  and `element_type_change` (storage/compact.rs:380-392) keep the id.
- Hit: pull gets a read-only `Shared` view of the cached `Arc<RawAlignedBytes>` with the original
  strides/offset (context.rs:183-186, 201); push gets `check_out_buf_impl` with the caller's
  itemsize then an NdCopier copy (`OutBuf::set`, buf.rs:491-499, its only caller).
- Miss: push reads straight through, is NOT cached and evicts nothing (context.rs:205-207). Pull
  first evicts this id's stale entry (205-209), reads into the caller's slot, converts the result
  with `into_shared` (buf.rs:337-348: PoolBuf/PoolBufMut/Shared yes; borrowed Slice/SliceMut not
  cached, 223-229), puts a `Shared` view in the slot and inserts the entry; an entry the inner read
  inserted for the same id is returned to the pool (241-250).
- So a cached array's pull reads always yield read-only buffers. All in-crate `data_mut()` calls
  are on `materialize`d outs, not on pull results (checked at 0371e75).
- Scopes: `cache_scope(arrays_to_cache)` (context.rs:246-256) returns a guard that hides the
  enclosing scope's cache (enter 268-279) and restores it on drop (exit 282-291), returning the
  ended scope's buffers via `return_shared` (buf_pool.rs:59-63, pool only on the last ref).
  Entered by `to_buf_strided_checked` (read.rs:463), `compact_into_builder_dyn` (compact.rs:171),
  shape ops' `CacheScope::enter` (context.rs:123), reductions inside their closure
  (reduction/common.rs:241). `is_cache_enabled` mirrors `read_cache.is_some()` (67-69, 293-298).
  The `RefCell` borrow is never held across the unknown `read` (186, 196, 213); the re-borrow at
  241-247 `unwrap`s, relying on nested guards having restored this scope.
- Id propagation (params.rs:614-619, 867-951): `arrays_to_cache_potentially` = ids read at this
  array's index; `arrays_to_cache` = those reached twice. Elementwise ops merge inputs and add
  their own id; Compact adds its id (storage/compact.rs:215-216); Broadcast (broadcast.rs:99) and
  InsertDim with all new dims in front (insert_dim.rs:122-127) merge without a scope; other shape
  ops call `with_cache_scope` (params.rs:904-908); Concatenate merges with
  `repeats_across_inners = false` (concatenate.rs:155-160); reductions add their id after their
  scope (reduction/common.rs:203-206). Transmute/SubDtype/IntoType/Any forward the inner spec.

## Unsafe inventory

- read.rs:232, 321, 389, 454 `Index::new_unchecked` - local: `check_ranges` + preceding
  `contains(&0)` early return.
- read.rs:234-240 `from_raw_parts_mut(array.as_mut_ptr(), array.len())` over the uninit ndarray,
  `cast_slice_mut` (asserts, util/mod.rs:209-218), `from_slice_mut` with ndarray strides * itemsize
  - local (positive strides of an owned, possibly permuted, non-empty array).
- read.rs:243 `assume_init` - NON-LOCAL: full coverage by every push path (storages, slow-path
  pieces, cache-hit copy). Empty arrays skip the read and have 0 elements.
- read.rs:301 `from_slice_mut(buf, packed strides)` - exact length checked at :317.
- read.rs:550-554 `from_slice_mut(&mut out_buf[out_offset..], out_strides)` + piece `Index` -
  relies on `out` holding the region (entry check or own construction; the slice is bounds-checked
  only at its start) and on NdIterExtBlockOffsetSize (util/iter/block.rs) giving non-empty pieces
  inside the region.
- compact.rs:100 `into_table` - see Contracts.
- compact.rs:261 `chunk_buf.set_len(chunk_bytes)` uninit - NON-LOCAL push contract; compact.rs:264
  chunk `Index` - NOT established on 32-bit (see Suspicions); compact.rs:266-271 packed strides.
- compact.rs:300 / 338-340 `set_len` uninit - local: `fill(0)` for partial blocks, a full copy
  otherwise (`full_block`, :303); the compressed length relies on `encode` <= bound.
- compact.rs:314-323 `get_unchecked(src_byte_offset..)` + `NdCopier::copy` - relies on chunk_buf
  holding `chunk_size` (u64) elements at `chunk_strides`; true only if the usize chunk sizes at
  :266-267 did not truncate.
- construct.rs:150 `plain_ndarray_ptr` under the caller's contract; construct.rs:260 / 282 `write` / `write_unaligned` at `base.add(dst_offset)` - in bounds by
  `check_out_buf` (push) or `materialize` (pull); NdIter offsets are relative to `begin`
  (util/iter/strides.rs:32-39). The aligned path needs `dtype.alignment() >= align_of::<T>()`
  (Dtyped is an unsafe trait; non-local).
- context.rs:184-186, 231-233 `from_shared(..).with_offset(offset)` - entry recorded from a pull
  read of exactly this (id, start, size); non-local: same id => same layout of the same bytes (stated nowhere in the source: K167).
  buf.rs:497 `copy_from` in `OutBuf::set` - its caller (context.rs:188-190) checked `out`.
- cache_id.rs:36, 57, 68, 82, 99, 123, 145, 159, 172 `MaybeUninit` reads of the inline map -
  invariant "values[i] initialized iff keys[i].is_some()" (doc :27); spill (:75-86) and
  `clear_with` (:138-147) clear keys first so a panic leaks instead of double-dropping.

## Edge-case surface

- Empty regions: to_ndarray_sub returns an empty ndarray (ndarray zeroes every stride, test
  read.rs:767); to_buf_slice needs `buf.len() == 0`; to_buf_strided returns a 0-byte writable pool
  buffer whose layout strides may be 0 on long dims (`alloc_empty`, read.rs:441-445; harmless, an
  `out` is revalidated); to_buf_strided_into checks only stride count and writability and writes
  nothing (read.rs:433-435, test :926). Empty arrays compact with zero chunks and nblocks = 0.
- 0-d: nitems = 1 <= min_nitems (>= 1, params.rs:33-37), so 0-d reads are always small reads and
  the `Dim<0>` slow arm (read.rs:493) is effectively dead; compaction uses the DimDyn arm
  (compact.rs:156, test construct.rs:518).
- Length-1 dims are ignored by the overlap test; snapping a scaled dim to `array_shape`
  (util/mod.rs:515-521) keeps unaligned starts in one piece. 0-stride pull results (Scalar,
  Broadcast, pipeline collapsed dims) are read-only and may be cached as such; a caller `out`
  with a 0 stride on a len > 1 dim is rejected.
- Permuted / padded / offset outs: slow-path pieces use `out_strides` (read.rs:546-548);
  to_ndarray_sub allocates in `read_layout_order` (read.rs:209-229) so results may be F-order.
- NDIM_MAX: `check_ranges` errors; slow dispatch arms 0..=8 (read.rs:492-503), compaction arms
  1..=4 else DimDyn. Unaligned: to_buf_slice accepts a misaligned buf (test read.rs:738);
  compaction buffers are AlignedBytes at the dtype alignment (compact.rs:240-242).
- Struct dtypes with padding: storages that skip padding bytes leave chunk_buf bytes uninit and
  they are compressed (Miri-level); `assume_init` of padded `T` is fine.
- 32-bit: covered by `check_ranges` + `check_region_size` at the entries and in every storage.
  Unchecked: compact.rs:257-258 (NEW per-dim `as usize`, Suspicions), read.rs:294 (strides before
  any region check, Suspicions), compact.rs:307 (`block_in_chunk_idx as usize * ...`),
  compact.rs:209 (bounded by the 1 GiB block cap).
- Reentrancy: `map`/`reduce_unordered` closures are plain `Fn` (map.rs:37, custom.rs:312), so a
  closure may capture `&ReadContext` and run a nested top-level read on the SAME context mid-read;
  the nested scope hides and restores the outer cache (test storage/compact.rs:1096). The zstd
  `&mut` is scoped to one call (codec/mod.rs:284-289). compact_fn's `f` cannot reach the internal
  context (construct.rs:309). jix-py checks a context out of a Mutex per read
  (jix-py/src/array.rs:161-174).
- Aliasing: an `out` overlapping memory a Plain reads violates `from_raw_parts_mut`'s contract
  (buf.rs:93-97); the cached `Arc` has no writable alias once `into_shared` consumed its PoolBuf.

## Intentional behaviors

- Returned ndarrays are not necessarily C-contiguous (read.rs:31-31, 96-99; tests read.rs:794,
  837). No alignment is promised of pull buffers or required of outs (read.rs:320-322,
  core_trait.rs:88-92, buf.rs:22-24).
- to_buf_slice needs the EXACT byte length (read.rs:252-252), InvalidBufferSize otherwise.
- Read-only, wrongly-strided, too-small or self-overlapping outs fail with InvalidArgument before
  anything is written, also for split reads (tests read.rs:926, 982; buf.rs:565-598). The overlap
  test is conservative: interleaved disjoint layouts are rejected too (K103).
- An invalid index is reported before an ndim mismatch in to_ndarray_sub (test read.rs:990).
  `from_storage` validates the spec only under debug_assertions (mod.rs:321-351).
- compact_fn visits elements in arbitrary order (construct.rs:161-161); boundary blocks are
  zero-padded (compact.rs:121-121, 310-313); compact_with inherits unset params from the source
  (compact.rs:63-63, params.rs:230-258); MaybeCompact keeps an already compact source and ignores
  params (ops/maybe_compact.rs:32).
- `ReadContext` is Send but not Sync (context.rs:21-21, 102-105); `read_ctx()` and
  `ReadContext::default()` behave the same today, the decoder params are unused (context.rs:71).
- Integer arithmetic errors always fail a read, floats never report (#95, error.rs:313-317).
- Read cache (tests in storage/compact.rs:877-1320): only pull reads populate it; a push read of a
  cached region is served by a copy and not added (:1200); reading another region evicts the
  entry and live views stay valid (:891); nothing is cached outside a top-level read; borrowed
  (non-pool) views are never cached; shape ops other than Broadcast / front InsertDim clear ids and
  cache repeats in their own scope, so a repeated shape op is not cached at its level; Concatenate
  never caches arrays shared between its inputs; reductions drop their entries when their read
  ends (:1056); one entry per id per scope.
- `write_out_buf_slot` forgets an occupied slot's old buffer before asserting (buf.rs:509-513).

## Hot spots

All of context.rs and cache_id.rs is NEW; NEW items first.
- NEW (#103) compact.rs:256-272 vs :287-332: chunk sizes are usize for the read and buffer but
  u64 for the block loop. Do they ever disagree (32-bit, user `read_size`)?
- NEW (#103/#104) read.rs:173-439: usize arithmetic before the 32-bit region check (:316)?
  Empty-region paths as documented? 'a lifetimes of pull buffers through `view_mut` (:456)?
- NEW (#100) context.rs:163-243: can a hit serve another region, dtype or layout, or can two
  storages share an id with different data? Is every hit (which skips Compact's / ReductionOp's
  `check_out_buf`) preceded by a validated uncached read of that storage at that index?
- NEW: misses turn writable pull buffers into read-only `Shared`; does any consumer need a
  writable pull? Eviction while views are lent; the stale same-id entry from a pass-through
  inner read (test storage/compact.rs:1138); RefCell/Cell under nested scopes, reentrant reads,
  `?` with a filled slot, panics; the `unwrap` at context.rs:236.
- NEW cache_id.rs:63-179: MaybeUninit bookkeeping on spill, remove, clear_with, Drop, Clone, panics.
- NEW scope placement (read.rs:463 after the small_read decision; compact.rs:171 before tune) and
  id merging (params.rs:826-909): efficiency only, or can a wrong set cost correctness?
- Slow path read.rs:509-558: pieces disjoint/covering (unaligned starts, snapped dims, partial
  last pieces), `out_offset` for permuted/padded outs. to_ndarray_sub read.rs:209-243:
  `inv_order`, len-1 strides, `assume_init` coverage.
- compact_with (compact.rs:85-105) encodes with params tuned in compact_into_builder, then
  re-tunes in `into_spec`; only debug_asserts compare geometry (storage/compact.rs:203-214). Is
  `tune` idempotent? Block_index (compact.rs:273-293) vs the C-order grid; FnStorage aligned write.

### Suspicions (unverified)

- [CONFIRMED in batch7-1 as K154] compact.rs:257-258, 273, 325 - NEW in c28c62a: on 32-bit `chunk_size[dim] as usize` and
  `product as usize * itemsize` truncate. With a user `read_size` >= 4 GiB (params.rs:170) and a
  dim >= 2^32 (lazy compact_fn / broadcast; tune allows dims <= i64::MAX), e.g. a 1-D chunk of
  2^32+1 elements becomes a 1-element read into a 1-element buffer that passes every storage
  check, while the block loop still walks the u64 chunk and `get_unchecked(src_byte_offset..)`
  reads past chunk_buf (OOB read UB); a truncation to 0 also breaks the `Index` NonZero invariant.
  Before #103 the u64 range reached the storage's region check and failed cleanly.
- [CONFIRMED in batch7-1 as K157] read.rs:294 - `default_strides_slice` (unchecked usize mul, util/mod.rs:182-191) runs before
  `check_get_buffer_size` and before `check_region_size` (which now follows the empty return).
  On 32-bit an empty region with huge extents (the K120 trigger, e.g. [0, 2^31, 2^31] u8 of a
  broadcast) or a huge non-empty region overflows: debug panic instead of Ok / InvalidBufferSize;
  release wraps harmlessly. Looks like a K120 regression from #103 (low).
